title: M3.1 Pedagogical Quality Engine design
purpose: Freeze the architecture, report contract, deterministic pedagogical-quality profile, AI-sandbox CLI, Atlas authoring-skill alignment, implementation scope and independent QA boundary for M3.1.
invariants: Existing learnit.kit.v2 schema and canonical validators remain normative and read-only.
The legacy V13.2 skill/validator are design evidence only and are not mechanically ported.
M3.1 quality analysis is deterministic, read-only, local and network-free.
No scalar quality score becomes a release authority.
Canonical validity, pedagogical quality and learner outcome claims remain distinct.
The same Python quality engine must serve CLI, CI and Studio; JavaScript may render but not reimplement rules.
AI self-iteration must stop rather than invent unsupported source content.
No document ingestion, LLM product integration, learner-runtime change, contract revision, Gate3, Gate4 or M4+ activation.
requiredEvidence: Stable report and CLI contracts frozen.
Exact implementation and independent-QA path sets frozen and disjoint.
Human-gate boundary frozen without authorizing product promotion.
adversarialTests: Reject any design that copies learnit.import.v1.1 fields into learnit.kit.v2.
Reject a numeric score as sole release gate.
Reject claims that static kit inspection proves learner mastery or effectiveness.
Reject source-provenance fields without a contract gate.
Reject implementation or QA path overlap.
independentReview: Linus architecture challenge recorded on authority issue #259.
Steve product/experience challenge recorded on authority issue #259.
Repository governance and PR scope gate the design PR.
Implementation requires a separate ATLAS-WP-012 authority after design acceptance.
rollback: Revert the two design files only. M3.0 promoted product and stable Pages publication remain unchanged.
